title: Tukong Austin

services.name: Adult Programs
services.desc: Headmaster Ali Brown began training in Tukong Moosul at age 8 and has taught children's programs for over 15 years. He understands what kids need - not just the kicks and blocks, but the mindset that carries over into school, friendships, and life. Our programs welcome children ages 4 and up, with no prior experience or fitness level required. Tukong pushes kids beyond their comfort zones in a safe, supportive environment. Whether your child struggles with bullying, a tough social situation, or just needs a confidence boost, our instructors provide the tools to build real self-esteem - on the mat and off it.
